report: 教材上傳功能獨立測試
scope: isolated in-memory SQLite database and temporary storage; live Docker volume was not used or modified

matrix.evidence: Real PPTX was quarantined, released to ready, and exposed only safe metadata; storage_key was absent from the projection.
Same-owner re-upload returned deduplicated=true and one SHA row; a different owner could not use a private asset, then could see/use it after school scope.
Two materials in two courses referenced the same asset; draft materials were hidden and published materials were visible to the enrolled student.
Allowed download bytes, size and SHA matched the fixture; allowDownload=false and an unenrolled student were denied; unsafe filename was rejected.
Student library listing and asset binding were denied; teacher/admin scope behavior was enforced.

Forged PPTX/DOCX/PDF/ZIP, MIME-extension mismatch, path-like filename, empty signature and over-25MiB payloads were rejected. No malformed asset reached ready status. HTTP invalid/canonical-empty base64 returned 400 invalid_base64 with zero asset rows.

After the fix, isolated real Backend HTTP POST conversion returned 202 queued with output_asset_id=null; GET conversion status returned 200 with queued, output_asset_id=null, started_at=null and finished_at=null. No SQLite column error, updated_at or completed_at field, preview URL, or successful-preview claim was returned.

Source/rendered contract and production build verified teacher material library/course selection controls, file accept list, progress/error/retry selectors, scope, bilingual metadata, allowDownload, draft/publish and honest waiting-for-conversion copy. Full authenticated browser upload interaction was not claimed in this independent run.
Personally rerun: targeted phase2 14/14, full regression 55/55, TypeScript noEmit, ESLint, Vinext build, docker compose health and compose smoke.

conversion_http_recheck.isolation: temporary SQLite file and temporary storage removed after run

resolved_defects.title: Conversion status endpoint selected columns absent from migration schema
resolved_defects.recheck: Real Backend HTTP flow in an isolated database returned POST 202 and GET 200; queued output and timestamps were null and no SQLite column error occurred.

defects.title: Authenticated browser upload flow not claimed by this run
defects.reproduction: N/A; test boundary rather than confirmed product failure.
defects.observed: Source/rendered contracts and build passed; no stored credential was entered and no live data was changed.
defects.impact: The teacher upload UI still needs a deliberate authenticated browser acceptance pass before formal UI sign-off.

defects.title: Buildx session-header environment risk
defects.reproduction: Parallel docker compose build can hit a BuildKit session-header error; sequential/legacy-builder build succeeded.
defects.observed: Environment/tooling issue, not a material-library behavior failure.
defects.impact: CI/local image build should retain a sequential fallback until the Buildx runtime is corrected.

known_limitations: PPT/PPTX conversion worker is not configured; queued/waiting status is expected and must not be shown as a successful preview.
No secrets, tokens or personal credentials are included in this evidence.

personally_executed: inline isolated Backend HTTP course/unit/material/conversion recheck
inherited_or_not_used: No prior worker conclusion was used as proof for the matrix.
No live-volume browser credential test was used as proof.
